answer: Beacon audits hold back the tide of fakes. Each agent posts a 60-unit deposit, then answers a beacon challenge every 10 minutes with a compute heartbeat. The beacon picks 5% at random, so no operator can guess which timber-built fakes get called. Miss twice, freeze 20 epochs, deposit lost. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 units plus 3,000 compute per epoch; the cedar log flags lockstep clusters. Honest agents pay once; heartbeat is normal work.
